title: Subversive Ideas
wikitext:
{{Quest infobox | name = Subversive Ideas | map = [[Image:Subversive Ideas map.jpg|250px]] | campaign = Prophecies | region = Southern Shiverpeaks | type = Secondary | repeatable = y | given by = [[Molachev]] | given at = [[Sorrow's Furnace]] }} Help [[Molachev]] deliver secret messages to [[Dredge Slave]]s in order to incite their desire for freedom from the slavery of the [[Stone Summit]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== Enter [[Sorrow's Furnace]] without [[To Sorrow's Furnace]] subquests. ===Objectives=== * Deliver 5 [[Scroll of Rebellious Rhetoric|Scrolls of Rebellious Rhetoric]] to the Dredge Slaves. * See [[Molachev]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 6,000 [[Experience]] ==Walkthrough== This quest does not guide you with any quest marker. As you wander around [[Sorrow's Furnace]], you will come across many [[Dredge Slave]]s scattered about singly. Simply talk to the first five that you come across to complete the quest. It's useful to perform this quest while doing [[Tasca's Reprise]] and [[Political Ramifications]], the other two quests that require that the main [[To Sorrow's Furnace|Sorrows Furnace]] quests not be active. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''Molachev''' :''"My people have been oppressed for so long they think freedom is just a dream. I need someone to disseminate these Scrolls of Rebellious Rhetoric to help enlighten them.
It will be dangerous; many are blinded by fear and will react violently to rebellious ideas...but others are willing to listen, if you can find them.
Will you help?"'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'm happy to help. | decline = I don't think so. | ask = Remember, give the scrolls to those who seem open to speaking with you. Others may attack. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== Each Dredge Slave you give the scroll to will respond with one of the following lines (apparently selected randomly): :''"Do you really think it's possible to break our bonds? Imagine..."'' :''"Our years of thankless toil in these mines have left many anxious for rebellion. Thank you, friend. These words are just the spark..."'' :''"Someday...I know that this Stone Summit empire will be tomorrow's ashes. Those words bring us the strength to carry on with our fight."'' :''"Thank you. My final days will be spent making the [[Stone Summit]] pay for my service."'' :''"Thank you, friend, this is good news indeed. We shall overcome!"'' :''"Your words give me the strength to do what I must. [[Villnar Painforge|Vilnar Painforge]] {{sic}} personally watched as he had his followers kill my family. One day, it will be my turn to return the favor."'' ===Reward dialogue=== '''Molachev''' :''"Our message spreads. More and more Dredges are coming over to the cause. The rebellion is in your debt."''
